title: Hidden Acres

services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: On the last day of camp you are welcome to join us for closing ceremonies at 4:00 p.m. Checkout will follow closing at approximately 4:30 p.m. Our co-ed day camp program is a great opportunity to spend time outside and connect with others while enjoying age-appropriate activities such as swimming, canoeing, archery, nature exploration, rock-climbing, sports, group games and more! Hidden Acres is interested in the development of the whole person and is committed to providing a fun, healthy, stimulating and safe experience for all campers. services.desc: Our fun, creative and hands-on outdoor education school programs serve around 2000 students per year. Hendricks). Students will also have opportunities to develop stronger relationships with their peers and teachers and improve their intellectual, moral and physical development.
